content.comment_body: I'm experiencing an issue with text blocks in the [product_name] editor, version [version_no]. When editing text on the [product_name] display screen, everything appears fine initially. However, after closing and reopening the program file, some text—specifically the last 8 columns on the second screen (20 characters wide)—is missing in certain blocks. I've attached a partial file that consistently shows this error. The affected blocks are [article_no], [article_no], [article_no], and [article_no] (see the attached image). In one block, when trying to add a bar graph sized at 20, it reverts to 12 after reopening. I'm unsure how to upload the source file, but I believe the issue is clear.

It’s already known in the German forum that [product_name] version [version_no] has issues in this area. See: [url] There’s also another bug present in this software version. My recommendation: If you don’t require the new [product_name] hardware, avoid upgrading and stay on the previous version.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are facing persistent data loss and display problems when editing text blocks and bar graph sizes in the [product_name] editor, notably with [version_no]. Edits such as text and graphics properties may be lost or altered after saving and reopening files, and the issue seems consistent in specific blocks. Another user has confirmed this is a documented problem with the referenced version, suggesting functionality has regressed compared to earlier releases.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect that all text and graphical edits will remain intact and accurate after saving and reopening files, ensuring reliable data and display integrity.
